title: Deeper/broader FreeCAD importer-source and explicit-3D consumer boundary
scope: Inspect current FreeCAD C++ DXF importer shape dispatch and the DWG wrapper handoff.
Reconcile source-level consumer applicability with existing explicit-geometry, 2D compatibility, and ACIS/ACDS evidence gates.
Refresh relevant open-source peer status without duplicating existing findings or promoting support.

sources.observed: The generic geometry-builder fallback creates a Part::Feature and comments 3DFACE as an example. A search of this source file found no explicit MESH or 3DSOLID dispatch strings.
does_not_establish: Runtime acceptance or geometric fidelity of 3DFACE on every FreeCAD build.
Absence of MESH or 3DSOLID handling from every FreeCAD importer, add-on, or alternate route.
ACIS/SAB parsing, DWG AcDs ownership, or B-rep semantic support.

sources.observed: The DWG open route calls convertToDxf() and then delegates the produced path to importDXF.open().
does_not_establish: Successful converter exit or correct converter output based only on a returned path.
Semantic correctness of the resulting FreeCAD document.

sources.observed: Issues #123, #124, #125, #127, and #130–#135 include peer-reported bounds/count, angle-unit, ownership, object-loss, codepage, TABLE, MLeader-context, and class/version-specific parsing behavior. These map to existing local plan owners.
does_not_establish: A released peer fix unless its exact package contains it and is independently rerun.
A format rule or universal support claim.

sources.observed: Signed v3.8.0 at 3a1c66b is the latest formal release identified in this review; its listed change is assembly visibility.
does_not_establish: ACIS DXF writer support from open PR #1240.
Per-family or semantic correctness for every advertised version.

sources.observed: PR #1240 remains distinct open ACIS-writer work, not part of the released baseline identified here.

plan_changes: Refine the existing native FreeCAD consumer matrix to include a minimal explicit 3DFACE case as a source-supported candidate route, alongside the existing common-2D controls.
Keep MESH, inline SAT/SAB, and DWG AcDs/SAB as separate applicability rows; source-file search absence is not treated as a complete negative runtime result.
Keep direct DXF import separate from DWG-to-DXF conversion followed by FreeCAD import; capture converter identity, status, output identity/version, and diagnostics before judging imported semantics.
Reuse existing peer issue owners and preserve the current focused-per-slice / composed-native-checkpoint cadence.
limitations: FreeCAD main and peer issue/release pages are mutable; exact revisions must be captured before a runtime comparison.
The C++ importer source dispatch is only one route and does not establish complete FreeCAD consumer capabilities.
No local defect or independent semantic 3D support claim is inferred.
